newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan to auction six-yr JGB on Tuesday - traders.
newsitem.headline: Japan to auction six-yr JGB on Tuesday - traders.

text.p: The Ministry of Finance (MOF) is likely to offer six-year Japanese government bonds (JGBs) through a price-competitive auction on Tuesday, traders said on Friday.
The coupon rate for the new bond is likely to be set at 1.9 percent after Friday's sharp price rises in the JGB market, traders said.

"There was a slight hope that the coupon rate might be set at 2.0 percent, but that is unlikely after today's rally on Japan's weaker-than-expected industrial output data," said a dealer at a commercial bank's securities unit.
When the MOF last auctioned six-year bonds on May 8, it offered 500 billion yen worth at 1.8 percent.
